scope: Two bounded diagnostic PIE trials after static source/log correlation; no Gate100/200/300 run was started.

trials.name: preserve_conflict_wait_age_until_resource_exit
trials.result: Liveness regression fixed, but the lifetime severe-overlap gate still failed.

trials.name: infer_next_lane_from_authoritative_route_before_short_path_exposes_transition
trials.result: Overlap was prevented, but the conservative reservation caused an unacceptable liveness and performance regression; the change was reverted.

localized_overlap.interpretation: Both entities reached progress zero on outgoing lanes sharing the same three-way junction.

formal_conclusion: OpenSpec 4.5 remains incomplete. The retained wait-age fix is a measured liveness improvement, not a Gate30 pass.
